newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Smart eyes 12 to 20 pesos IPO price.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Smart eyes 12 to 20 pesos IPO price.

text.p: Smart Communications Inc said on Wednesday it expects to raise an amount ranging from 5.4 billion pesos to nine billion pesos from its proposed initial public offering (IPO).

In an application filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Smart, the telecommunications subsidiary of Metro Pacific Corp, said the price per share will range from a minimum of 12 pesos to a maximum of 20 pesos.
The company plans to offer 450 million shares or 20 percent of its common shares in an IPO set tentatively for June this year.
Proceeds of the IPO will be used to finance the company's expansion plans (40 percent), repay loans (25 percent) and finance working capital (10 percent).
The rest of the proceeds will be used to acquire additional shares in Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc, an international gateway facility operator and a unit of Cable & Wireless.
Last year, Smart bought a 9.8 percent stake in Eastern Telecommunications.
